name: webapp-testing

summary.en: Anthropic’s toolkit for driving a local web app with Playwright: checking frontend behavior, capturing screenshots and reading browser logs.
summary.zh: Anthropic 出品，用 Playwright 驱动本地 Web 应用：检查前端行为、截图并读取浏览器日志。

upstreamDescription: Toolkit for interacting with and testing local web applications using Playwright. Supports verifying frontend functionality, debugging UI behavior, capturing browser screenshots, and viewing browser logs.
